scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.merge-dist: powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist-all; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist-all/client; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist-all/server; Copy-Item client/dist/* dist-all/client -Recurse; Copy-Item server/dist/* dist-all/server -Recurse"
scripts.build-all: npm run build && npm run merge-dist
